name: Kameyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kameyama city emblem in green: a stylised mountain range of two arches in two shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Kameyama, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 31 March 2005.

features.role: Kameyama city emblem — a stylised mountain range of two arches in two shades of green
